campaign.title: Atomically lower the provider cap and alter one dependent threshold.

initial.code:
FUNCTION G40_09_RENAMED(X)
  G40_09_RENAMED = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    G40_09_RENAMED = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 120) THEN
    G40_09_RENAMED = 120
  END IF
  G40_09_RENAMED = G40_09_RENAMED
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_09_PRED_1(X)
  G40_09_PRED_1 = 0
  IF (G40_09_RENAMED(X) >= 40) THEN
    G40_09_PRED_1 = 1
  END IF
  G40_09_PRED_1 = G40_09_PRED_1
END FUNCTION
